rows.label: bf04390100_0040
rows.name:
I won't let you misuse Grandpa's research
anymore, mo!

rows.label: bf04390100_0050
rows.name: I-if I do that, I'll suffer huge losses, mo!

rows.label: bf04390100_0060
rows.name: I've invested a lot in this project, mo!

rows.label: bf04390100_0070
rows.name:
Hmph. Then maybe I'll hand you
over to the Imperial Army.

rows.label: bf04390100_0080
rows.name:
They've probably got their eye on you
for what you had Kiku do, too.

rows.label: bf04390100_0090
rows.name:
You've probably been doing plenty
of other bad things, haven't you?

rows.label: bf04390100_0105
rows.name:
I didn't know you were
such an underhanded guy, mo.

rows.label: bf04390100_0120
rows.name:
Fine, mo. I'll stop producing
artificial Blades, mo.

rows.label: bf04390100_0130
rows.name:
That guy still has his uses.
It'd be a problem if you interfered.
